entries.title: Your first mate and crew can search, read and save your Google Drive files
entries.body: The Google row now adds Drive. Your first mate and crew can search your Drive, read a file as text, and save a file into a task's folder, with a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides deck saved as PDF or as an Office file. Each Drive action starts out asking you first, and none deletes, moves, shares or changes a file. If you signed in to Google before this version, Gmail and Calendar keep working, and the row says Drive, Docs and Sheets not added: press Sign in again and leave Drive ticked on Google's page.

picture.alt: The Google row in Settings → Integrations saying Drive, Docs and Sheets not added, explaining that Gmail and Calendar keep working, with a Sign in again button
